forbidden: edge-distance or band membership computed other than via bucket_facts_from_instrument_id
selecting a boot commit by committer time
touching open_holdout or any M1-v3 path
freeze_order: land WP1c code; recompute TE2_PINS.head_blob_sha256 over every scripts/analysis/fq_loss_taxonomy_*.py + fq_v1_loss_taxonomy.py at that HEAD; commit this predeclaration; record its commit sha in TE2_PINS.json; commit TE2_PINS.json

honest_expectation.expected_verdict: INCONCLUSIVE unless a positive finding exists (material K1a, K4, a T-WIN rejection, or a T-SPREAD/T-ART rejection)
honest_expectation.floors_immutable: the 0.8 power floor and alpha values may not be changed after freeze
honest_expectation.inconclusive_means: uninformative: it neither supports 'no defect' nor 'bad luck'
honest_expectation.not_permission_to_rearm: INCONCLUSIVE, like every verdict, is NOT permission to re-arm; routes are T1 (12-07), T2, T3 only
honest_expectation.reason: T-WIN cluster power 0.248 (7 clusters) / 0.341 (6 clusters) under binding H1-K fee_net, below the 0.8 floor; T-SPREAD power 0.091 / 0.140

leave_one_out_rule: Outside the alpha budget. Drop the cluster with the largest P_c (ties to the alphabetically first station). If the dropped cluster is a WIN cluster recompute w_obs on the remaining clusters (w_obs - 1); if a loss cluster w_obs is unchanged. Retest at alpha 0.02. Can only block VARIANCE or add the single-cluster-driven label; a leave-one-out rejection with a full-sample non-rejection routes to INCONCLUSIVE.
near_boundary_rule: reflog entry < 120 s before boot: compare widened-path tree shas of pinned commit and reflog predecessor; if they differ the boot is UNTESTABLE unless p-hat reproduces under BOTH | NOTE: for boot 2 the manifest and artefact are byte-identical across 60290e9d and 99067d4a, so the dual reproduction is near-tautological; pin label stays INFERRED
open_items: predeclaration_commit (in TE2_PINS.json) is filled only after this file is committed
head_blob_sha256 in TE2_PINS.json must be recomputed if any pinned module changes before the freeze commit

p_c_rule.P_d: min(1, sum p-hat over the bought rungs of the station-day)
p_c_rule.independent_union_value: 1 - prod(1 - P_d), clamped, used in power only
p_c_rule.rule: P_c = max over the cluster P_d, clamped to <= 1 - 1e-9

phase_b_tie_reevaluation_rule: After ties are dropped, recompute testability on n-prime clusters with the same rule. A test dropping to a weaker status is reported as such; if NOT-TESTABLE or CONDITIONAL it cannot feed the VARIANCE clause. Shrinking Holm k after ties is acceptable: a member that cannot reject never affects validity.
pin_rule: last reflog entry <= boot time from the committed snapshot (branch first, HEAD fallback); never committer time; corroborate manifest+artefact blob sha at the pinned commit

s0i.H1_K_convention: BINDING: H1-K_fee_net = min(1, sum_fills(a + 0.0695*a*(1-a))); H1-K_ask_only is a labelled sensitivity
s0i.gate: outcome-blind; computed from the Phase A table only with scripts/analysis/fq_loss_taxonomy_stats.py
s0i.power_definitions: reject region {W <= w*}, w* the largest w with P_H0(W<=w) <= 0.02; cluster power = min over {max-P_c, independent-union P_c}; T-SPREAD power against H1-S (each q_c doubled, capped at 1); T-LOC and T-ART power not computed (min attainable p is the substitute)
s0i.rules: T-WIN TESTABLE iff min p <= 0.02; T-ART TESTABLE iff min p <= 0.01; Holm members: min p > 0.02 NOT-TESTABLE and dropped before Holm (k shrinks), k = remaining count, step-1 threshold 0.02/k, min p <= 0.02/k TESTABLE, else TESTABLE-CONDITIONAL; same rule in the 6-cluster sensitivity
s0i.t_spread_power_alpha_note: upper bound on power; at Holm step-1 0.01 power is lower; conclusion unaffected

scope.k1b: climate day > terminal_climate_day (5 fills, 3 station-days); bookkeeping flag only
scope.unit: station-day; cluster = station-event (consecutive climate days at one station, a gap of more than one day splits)

sensitivity_rules.k1b_exclusion: exclude the 5 fills on climate day 10-06 (3 station-days): 6 clusters, 11 station-days, 20 fills; testability recomputed with the identical rule; verdict stays on the full 25 fills
sensitivity_rules.scope_sensitive: a decision that flips under the exclusion is reported as scope-sensitive with both results
sensitivity_rules.station_day_level: reported as a sensitivity; if its decision differs from the cluster level the verdict is the cluster-level one and the range is stated

taxonomy.edge_dist_f: integer degF distance from tmax to the nearest edge of the inclusive interval from bucket_facts_from_instrument_id; 0 inside; open side never nearest; ^no leg uses the YES interval

flag_rules.K1a: S0-D reproduction miss surviving root cause, or available_at > now_ns, or vector.climate_day != instrument climate day; feeds FIXABLE only if material
flag_rules.K2: cycle in use is not the newest visible at now_ns, or age exceeds the cycle-age maximum; descriptive | age arm: cycle_age_maximum (50400 s, age > value)
flag_rules.K3: outcome flips when ASOS/METAR max replaces CLI tmax; descriptive, never fixable
flag_rules.K4: venue-resolved outcome differs from slug-parsed outcome; uses reconcile.py settlement leg
flag_rules.LOC_ARTEFACT: |corrected median error| > |raw median error|; inference only via T-ART
flag_rules.LOC_SOURCE: raw NBM median error alone beyond +-1 sd

taxonomy.k5_k6_k7_k9_k10_note: no K8; class counts per fill plus a separate station-day-level K7 count

rules.BAND_SELECTION: loser on a station-day with >= 2 bought rungs all lost, PIT in [0.10, 0.90], not BOUNDARY; needs complete partition else UNTESTABLE for that station-day; applied per fill with that fill own edge_dist_f
rules.BODY_MISS: residual loser (edge_dist_f >= 2, none of the above); renamed from K9 VARIANCE
rules.SIBLING_WON: losing fill on a station-day containing a winning fill; checked before BOUNDARY/TAIL/BAND_SELECTION/BODY_MISS
rules.TAIL: loser, PIT outside [0.05, 0.95]; exclusive with BOUNDARY
rules.WIN: fill inclusive interval [lower_f, upper_f] contains tmax; taxonomy applies to losers only

T-ART.statistic: exact paired sign test on d = |corrected error| - |raw error|, null 0.5

T-EDGE.statistic: exact P(X >= k), count of losing fills with edge_dist_f == 1

T-LOC.collapse_rule: cluster statistic S_c = sign of the cluster-mean signed error (tmax - corrected median); p = max of the two-sided exact p under all-pi_min and all-pi_max vectors; bound NOT proven for unequal pmfs
companions: same test on raw NBM median
T-LOC.null: pi_d = P(tmax > median | tmax != median) from the model discrete pmf of that day EARLIEST fill
T-LOC.ties: zero-error clusters dropped, n after drops reported
T-LOC.two_sided_formula_definition: p = min(1, 2*min(upper_tail(pis, n_pos), lower_tail(pis, n_pos))) over the Poisson-binomial count of positive cluster signs

T-SPREAD.attribution: spread vs location NOT identified; never attributed to spread alone
T-SPREAD.per_cluster: A_c = 1 if any fill is a tail miss; q_c = min(1, sum q_f over the cluster fills) (union upper bound)
T-SPREAD.per_day: q_d = min(1, sum q_f over the day fills)
T-SPREAD.per_fill_rule: PIT of tmax under the pmf of THAT fill decision cycle; tail miss iff mid-PIT outside [0.05, 0.95]; q_f = null tail probability from the same pmf
T-SPREAD.statistic: X = sum A_c, Poisson-binomial over q_c; p = P(X >= x_obs)

T-WIN.companion: H0-K: ask-implied probability net of theta*p*(1-p) fees, same max-over-cluster rule and clamp
T-WIN.statistic: P(W <= w_obs), W = sum W_c, W_c ~ Bernoulli(P_c) independent (H0-M)

thresholds_documented.k1a_materiality_rule: material iff it flips the take/no-take decision OR |delta p-hat| > 0.01
thresholds_documented.s0d_stop_rule: STOP if fewer than 23 of 25 p-hat match to 1e-9, counting UNTESTABLE as a non-match

tie_handling: sign tests and T-LOC drop zeros and report n after drops; T-WIN has no ties

verdict_rules.FIXABLE_DEFECT: any fill carries K4, or any material K1a; K3, K2, K1b, UNTESTABLE, CYCLE_AMBIGUOUS never produce FIXABLE; the statistical label is still reported alongside
verdict_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: everything else, with the reason stated
verdict_rules.MODEL_LIMITATION: no material K1a or K4 and at least one Holm- or T-ART-valid rejection among {T-SPREAD, T-ART}; T-LOC rejection reported alongside, never qualifies alone; sublabel ARTEFACT (T-ART), SOURCE (T-SPREAD rejects, T-ART does not), or ARTEFACT+SOURCE
verdict_rules.MODEL_MISCALIBRATED_UNATTRIBUTED: T-WIN rejects, no qualifying secondary rejects (indicative T-LOC ignored, noted), no material K1a or K4; qualifiers single-cluster-driven (leave-one-out does not reject) and secondaries NOT-TESTABLE
verdict_rules.VARIANCE: T-WIN fails to reject, T-WIN TESTABLE with cluster power >= 0.8, leave-one-out does not reject, at least one secondary unconditionally TESTABLE after ties (CONDITIONAL, NOT-TESTABLE and indicative T-LOC do not count), no qualifying TESTABLE secondary rejects; label weak unless every unconditionally TESTABLE secondary has computed power >= 0.8
verdict_rules.mixed: ranked list with share of loss, never one label
verdict_rules.valid_rejection: TESTABLE rejecting, or TESTABLE-CONDITIONAL rejecting only after the other Holm member rejected at step 1; NOT-TESTABLE never
